inventory_completion_explanation: The twelve declared roadmap families were decomposed into six nonduplicate carrier/relation/record/evidence/falsification obligations apiece. The count emerges from this explicit ownership decomposition, not from a requested target.
later_full_field_extensions: complete precision cosmic-history and early-universe evidence

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if source identity, direction, distance, time or state is erased.
obligations.statement: An astronomical source is a bounded carrier whose state produces or alters a registered signal along a declared path.
obligations.title: Astronomical source

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if frame, clock, site or calibration changes without record.
obligations.statement: An observer is a source-located site, platform, instrument and clock relation, not an unlocated view.
obligations.title: Astronomical observer

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if propagation, detector response or non-detection is omitted.
obligations.statement: A signal retains source, path, band, arrival, detector response and quality status.
obligations.title: Astronomical signal

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject an unframed coordinate or an epoch-free moving position.
obligations.statement: Angular position is a direction in a named frame and epoch with motion and uncertainty retained.
obligations.title: Angular position and reference frame

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if one distance method silently substitutes for another.
obligations.statement: Distance is a method-bound source-observer relation whose ladder, calibration and range remain explicit.
obligations.title: Astronomical distance

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a non-detection or missing row becomes ordinary zero or confirmed absence.
obligations.statement: Selection, detection, upper limit, non-detection, missing and outside-footprint status remain distinct.
obligations.title: Survey selection and non-detection

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if blended or ambiguous detections are forced into one object.
obligations.statement: Object identity is a reconstructible association of observations across epochs and channels.
obligations.title: Astronomical object identity

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a label replaces its evidence or an uncertain class becomes certain.
obligations.statement: Classification retains measured features, method, alternatives and taxonomy version.
obligations.title: Astronomical classification

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject population inference from favorable detections alone.
obligations.statement: A population is a selection-bounded set with membership, volume, time, weights and censoring retained.
obligations.title: Astronomical population

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if resolution or projection is erased.
obligations.statement: Morphology is a resolution- and band-bound organization of distinguishable components.
obligations.title: Astronomical morphology

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a line identification or abundance is detached from its method.
obligations.statement: Composition inference retains species evidence, excitation, method and alternatives.
obligations.title: Astronomical composition inference

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if catalogue version, query or quality filtering is hidden.
obligations.statement: A catalogue is a versioned transformation with row provenance, flags, crossmatches and missingness.
obligations.title: Astronomical catalogue

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if apparent brightness is relabelled intrinsic luminosity.
obligations.statement: Received flux and source luminosity remain distinct through distance, geometry, band and attenuation records.
obligations.title: Flux and luminosity

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject an uncalibrated or selectively cropped feature set.
obligations.statement: A spectrum is an ordered calibrated signal with resolution, response, features and continuum retained.
obligations.title: Astronomical spectrum

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if measured redshift alone is treated as a unique distance or cause.
obligations.statement: Redshift is an emitted-to-observed feature relation; motion, gravity and expansion causes remain distinguishable.
obligations.title: Astronomical redshift

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if apparent and physical motion are conflated.
obligations.statement: Motion retains frame, epochs, baseline, components and uncertainties.
obligations.title: Astrometric and radial motion

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if sampling aliases or missing intervals are erased.
obligations.statement: Variability is source change observed through a declared cadence and window with gaps retained.
obligations.title: Astronomical variability

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a finite window manufactures a period or erases recurrence.
obligations.statement: Periodic recurrence, quasi-periodicity and one-time transience remain distinct temporal classes.
obligations.title: Periodicity and transient distinction

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a final star is used as its own formation record.
obligations.statement: Stellar formation is a source-dated assembly history from bound material to sustained stellar state.
obligations.title: Stellar formation

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if model state is relabelled direct interior observation.
obligations.statement: A stellar state retains layers, mass, radius, composition, energy transport and observation boundary.
obligations.title: Stellar structure

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if missing energy or species is fitted away.
obligations.statement: Stellar energy follows species through a complete reaction and loss ledger.
obligations.title: Stellar energy generation

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a population ordering is silently treated as one star's history.
obligations.statement: Stellar evolution is a causal state sequence with initial conditions and mass loss retained.
obligations.title: Stellar evolution

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if unresolved binaries or selection effects are ignored.
obligations.statement: A stellar population retains selection, distance, extinction, binaries and completeness.
obligations.title: Stellar population

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if remnant class is inferred without progenitor and event boundaries.
obligations.statement: Terminal state links progenitor, transition, remnant and ejecta without erasing alternatives.
obligations.title: Stellar terminal state

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if candidates or unseen completeness are treated as confirmed bodies.
obligations.statement: A planetary system is a host-and-body organization with orbits, interactions and detection limits retained.
obligations.title: Planetary-system identity

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if fitted elements replace observations or an open trajectory is called bound.
obligations.statement: An orbit is a frame- and epoch-bound recurrent state sequence with perturbations and uncertainty.
obligations.title: Astronomical orbit

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject a near ratio without phase recurrence or a lock without history.
obligations.statement: Resonance is joint recurrence; tidal locking additionally retains dissipative history.
obligations.title: Orbital resonance and tidal state

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if taxonomy supplies a physical law or uncertain mass is hidden.
obligations.statement: Planet, satellite and dwarf classifications retain dynamical context and measured features.
obligations.title: Planet and satellite classification

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if an instrumental or stellar signal is silently promoted to a planet.
obligations.statement: An exoplanet claim retains host, method, signal, selection, stellar activity and alternatives.
obligations.title: Exoplanet observation

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if detected objects are treated as the complete population.
obligations.statement: Small-body inference retains survey selection, orbit, activity, composition and completeness.
obligations.title: Small-body population

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if phases or unseen components are collapsed into one medium.
obligations.statement: The interstellar medium is a multiphase carrier with species, dust, fields and transfers retained.
obligations.title: Interstellar-medium identity

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if extinction and emission models are conflated.
obligations.statement: Dust inference retains grain properties, temperature, geometry and radiative method.
obligations.title: Astronomical dust

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if one tracer is assumed to equal total material without a bridge.
obligations.statement: A molecular cloud retains tracer, chemistry, density, motion and boundary.
obligations.title: Molecular cloud

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if abundance similarity proves unique provenance.
obligations.statement: Enrichment is a source-to-ejecta-to-medium history retaining species, mixing and losses.
obligations.title: Cosmic chemical enrichment

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject a universal rate from one tracer or region.
obligations.statement: Star-formation relations retain region, tracer, time, selection and controls.
obligations.title: Environment-to-star-formation relation

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if correlation alone establishes direction or conserved transfer.
obligations.statement: Feedback follows source outputs into medium response with energy, momentum and species ledgers.
obligations.title: Stellar feedback

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if morphology alone supplies identity or causal history.
obligations.statement: A galaxy is a bound multi-component organization with environment and history retained.
obligations.title: Galaxy identity

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if projected light is treated as complete mass structure.
obligations.statement: Galactic structure retains components, projection, kinematics and resolution.
obligations.title: Galactic structure

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a rotation curve uniquely identifies an untested mass model.
obligations.statement: Galactic dynamics retain tracers, baryons, unseen inference, geometry and alternatives.
obligations.title: Galactic dynamics

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if regression choice, selection or adverse rows are erased.
obligations.statement: The pre-source rank-four relation is tested against complete source-bound galaxy rows and residuals.
obligations.title: Luminosity-rotation scaling

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject progenitor bias or redshift selection erasure.
obligations.statement: Galaxy evolution distinguishes population sequence from individual causal history.
obligations.title: Galaxy evolution

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if projection or one mass proxy is treated as exact membership and mass.
obligations.statement: Cluster inference retains membership, gas, potential, selection and mass method.
obligations.title: Groups, clusters and environment

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if one signature uniquely fixes an unobserved interior.
obligations.statement: Compact-object identity retains source, environment, signals, method and alternatives.
obligations.title: Compact-object identity

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a theoretical limit replaces measurement.
obligations.statement: White-dwarf and neutron-star claims retain mass, radius, composition, rotation and field evidence.
obligations.title: Degenerate remnant classes

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if darkness alone proves a horizon or interior ontology.
obligations.statement: A black-hole claim retains dynamical mass, compactness, environment, messenger and alternatives.
obligations.title: Black-hole candidate and horizon evidence

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if one light-curve feature fixes a unique progenitor.
obligations.statement: A transient links source, event, localization, time, bands and afterglow with alternatives.
obligations.title: High-energy transient

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if temporal proximity alone proves common origin.
obligations.statement: Multi-messenger association retains localization, clocks, selection and background coincidence.
obligations.title: Multi-messenger association

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if detected events are treated as an unbiased population.
obligations.statement: Compact populations retain detection selection, censoring and source history.
obligations.title: Compact-object population

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if finite-volume uniformity is asserted without scale and selection.
obligations.statement: Large-scale organization is a survey- and scale-bound tracer distribution.
obligations.title: Large-scale statistical organization

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a visualization substitutes for a generated structure criterion.
obligations.statement: Web structure retains tracer, scale, method, selection and redshift.
obligations.title: Cosmic-web structure

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if one rung or probe silently sets the law.
obligations.statement: Expansion is a multi-probe distance-redshift record with calibration and covariance retained.
obligations.title: Cosmic expansion record

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a terminal value is detached from its ladder.
obligations.statement: A distance ladder is an explicit composition of anchors and rungs with covariance.
obligations.title: Distance-ladder composition

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if an image distortion uniquely identifies mass without alternatives.
obligations.statement: Lensing retains source, lens, observer, geometry, mass model and degeneracies.
obligations.title: Gravitational-lensing observation

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a fitted curve is relabelled direct cosmic history.
obligations.statement: Expansion history is an ordered reconstruction from independently retained probes.
obligations.title: Expansion-history inference

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a present background uniquely supplies all earlier states.
obligations.statement: Thermal history retains species, interaction, scale, temperature and evidence class by epoch.
obligations.title: Cosmic thermal history

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a component-separated map is called raw observation.
obligations.statement: CMB evidence retains frequency, calibration, beam, masks, foregrounds and covariance.
obligations.title: Cosmic microwave background

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a selected peak or harmonic fit erases adverse multipoles.
obligations.statement: Acoustic structure retains harmonic features, covariance and extraction boundary.
obligations.title: Background acoustic structure

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if current abundance is silently relabelled primordial.
obligations.statement: Primordial abundance inference retains species, sites, methods, depletion and stellar processing.
obligations.title: Primordial abundance record

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a model epoch is relabelled direct observation.
obligations.statement: Recombination links matter state, opacity and photon release with evidence boundaries.
obligations.title: Recombination and photon release

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if later structure uniquely reconstructs an unrecorded initial state.
obligations.statement: An early perturbation record retains scale, spectrum, covariance and transfer to later tracers.
obligations.title: Early perturbation record

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if one anomaly or prior preference uniquely selects a carrier.
obligations.statement: Dark-matter evidence is a cross-probe residual with baryons and alternatives retained.
obligations.title: Dark-matter evidence class

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if acceleration data alone fixes ontology or an equation of state.
obligations.statement: Dark-energy evidence retains distance, growth, calibration, covariance and alternatives.
obligations.title: Dark-energy evidence class

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if unobserved beyond-horizon state is relabelled observed absence.
obligations.statement: A horizon is an observer- and epoch-bound causal access limit under admitted propagation.
obligations.title: Cosmic horizon

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if mathematical possibility is counted as observation.
obligations.statement: Topology claims require observable repeated-pattern consequences and controls.
obligations.title: Cosmic topology claim

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if unobservability, anthropic selection or possibility is treated as confirmation.
obligations.statement: A multiverse claim enters empirical science only through a distinct observable consequence sealed before data.
obligations.title: Multiverse admissibility boundary

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if extrapolation uncertainty or alternative lawful continuation is erased.
obligations.statement: Ultimate fate is conditional continuation from current records and admitted laws, not an observed terminal state.
obligations.title: Cosmic ultimate-fate inference

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a catalogue regularity is promoted to premise-free law.
obligations.statement: Universal law, contingent initial condition and source-dated history remain separate.
obligations.title: Universal law and cosmic history distinction

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject opaque prediction or parameter fitting as derivation.
obligations.statement: A model output remains a conditional result compared with, not substituted for, observation.
obligations.title: Astronomical model-observation boundary

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject post-outcome target changes or favorable-row selection.
obligations.statement: A standing prediction is sealed before outcome and retains every adverse and missing row.
obligations.title: Standing astronomical prediction

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject argument from ignorance or hidden adverse controls.
obligations.statement: Unexplained means a source-bound residual after declared controls, not evidence for a preferred unknown cause.
obligations.title: Unexplained astronomical observation

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject an ambiguous signal or habitability proxy as life detection.
obligations.statement: Life or technology claims require replicated signals and complete abiotic, instrumental and contamination controls.
obligations.title: Astrobiology and technosignature boundary

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if an instrument selects a law or another branch's object is silently reowned.
obligations.statement: Astronomy consumes universal laws and exports source-dated constraints through explicit Physics, Engineering, Earth, Biology and Social boundaries.
obligations.title: Astronomy scientific handoffs

ownership_boundary.owned: Observed objects, populations, source states and cosmic histories.

scope: Source-observer geometry, astronomical evidence, objects and populations, radiation/motion/time, stars, planetary systems, interstellar matter and enrichment, galaxies, compact and multimessenger sources, expansion and large-scale structure, early universe/background/abundances, dark and horizon evidence, inference, prediction and typed handoffs.
